title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 2: Lifestyle Change and Public Persuasion
prompt: In many cities, people are aware of the health and environmental benefits of active lifestyles, yet many continue to rely on private cars for short journeys. Some commentators argue that persuasion through public information campaigns is more effective than financial penalties in changing such everyday habits. To what extent do you agree or disagree with this view? In your answer, state your position clearly, discuss both persuasion and financial penalties, and give your own opinion on which approach governments should prioritise. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有情境与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确题目要求你表达的是“同意/不同意”的立场，而非单纯描述现象。写作时需做到：第一，清晰陈述你对“宣传劝导优于经济处罚”这一观点的总体立场；第二，分别讨论宣传劝导与经济处罚在改变短途驾车习惯方面的作用与局限；第三，给出你自己关于政府应优先采用哪种方式的判断，并用理由或例子支持。注意任务回应完整、论点展开充分、段落衔接自然，并控制字数不少于250词。
